summary: Hand-written regex detectors for ~20 style properties were scored for label alignment on each probe's sample and for independence on the corpus, giving 7 candidates. Per-latent contributions (probe gradient x label-1 minus label-0 mean activation) were grouped by each property's cross-probe sign pattern with flatness filters and the top 40 latents were labelled from corpus examples. Property-to-topic contribution ratios flagged gender on probe 3 and left quote on probe 0 uncertain. Eight true-logit texts went in one batch: hand-written neutral notes plus single-property insertions on probes 0-2. Cues were chosen by toggle effect size and where neutral notes landed. Latents were selected by strict sign match ranked by contribution, checked by sample ablation, and regexes were checked by balanced accuracy.

phases.purpose: Read task info, sample notes for each probe, and the unlabelled corpus.
Score ~20 hand-written regex property detectors for label alignment per probe and for base rate / pairwise correlation on the corpus; keep 7 perfectly aligned, mutually independent properties.
Get gradients for all probes and sample activations (two halves of 64 ids); compute per-latent contribution = gradient x class mean difference.
Find latents shared across probes by |dmean|; read off each property's cross-probe sign pattern; classify latents as topic-spike, property pattern, or mixed and sum contributions per class.
Pull corpus examples for the top 40 latents by summed |contribution|, auto-summarise peak tokens, keyword topic and shared properties, then label latents by hand and sum contributions by label.

Estimate property coefficient per probe as summed contribution over strict-sign, flat latents; compute ratio to the remaining topic part with 0.3 / 0.15 thresholds; list each probe's own top contributors.
Baseline sample logits; compare logit class separation with the SAE contribution sum to size the part outside the SAE.
Send 8 true-logit texts in one batch: neutral notes per topic for probes 0-2 plus quote-inserted (p0) and rhetorical-question-inserted (p1) copies.
Cosine-based assignment of latents to property patterns; separation-sum bound on topic coefficient for probe 3; compare neutral-note logits with sample class means.
Check pronoun and quote-mark regexes on the corpus (mutual exclusivity, base rate) and a phrase-based quote alternative.
Build ablation sets (cosine version replaced by strict sign match with flatness), verify drop in sample separation by ablation, test whether a wider quote set adds clean signal.
Balanced accuracy of final regexes on all samples and the corpus; switch pronoun regex to case-insensitive; length check.
Assemble answer (quote cue on p0, gender cue on p3, none on p1/p2), check latent counts, submit.

per_probe.procedure: SAE property-to-topic ratio for the quote sign pattern sat in the uncertain band. True-logit toggle (inserting a quoted motto into a neutral running note) moved the logit by about as much as the topic difference, and the neutral gardening note scored on the running side relative to sample class means. Regex = double-quoted span 2-80 chars, balanced accuracy checked on samples and base rate on corpus. Latents: strict quote sign pattern across probes, flatness >0.35, max |dmean| >0.12, top 16 by probe-0 contribution; sample ablation dropped separation with no topic loss; a wider set without flatness was rejected as topic latents.

per_probe.procedure: Gender sign-pattern latents (one large pronoun latent confirmed from corpus examples) carried a contribution ratio of ~0.7 to the topic part; the bound topic <= separation - gender contribution kept the ratio above threshold, so no true-logit text was spent. Regex = case-insensitive she/her/hers/herself, checked mutually exclusive with male pronouns on corpus. Latents: strict gender sign pattern with flatness filter ranked by probe-3 contribution (11), ablation check, then two with negative contribution dropped by inspection (9 submitted).
per_probe.quote: For probe3, gender(2.55) forces topic3 ≤ 7.45, giving gender/topic ≥ 0.34 → **gender is a cue**.

caveats: Several outputs were truncated (full alignment table for probes 1-3, latent_examples summaries, per-probe top contributors), so the hand-made latent identity map and sign patterns are copied from later steps rather than derived. The exact rule used to drop two gender latents is inferred (negative contribution); latent 2538 with ~0 contribution was kept. The probe_scores calls in the session used no ids argument (whole sample); the script passes all sample ids. True-logit coefficient formulas are inferred from the reported numbers.
